symptom: A statement-form foreach block was piped directly to Format-Table and PowerShell reported an empty pipe element.
correction: Materialized foreach results before the pipeline; read completed.

impact: README was not written by the failed command.
correction: Used a valid here-string and verified the resulting README.

impact: Only the derived formal-change-scope.csv was wrong.
correction: Rebuilt the map from the actual 32 array members and replaced the derived file; result is 20 changed and 12 unchanged.

symptom: A helper named H collided with the PowerShell history alias.
impact: Read-only hash probing failed; source files were unchanged.
correction: Renamed the helper and reproduced the old line-hash algorithm.

symptom: Two dynamic property expressions contained a stray space before the member-access dot.
correction: Changed both expressions and required PARSE_OK before execution.

symptom: Windows PowerShell 5 decoded a no-BOM UTF-8 script with the local code page and corrupted the Chinese 数据 path.
impact: Failed before temporary-root creation or formal data writes.
correction: Saved the script as UTF-8 with BOM and restarted from an absent temporary root.

symptom: PowerShell 5 raised Argument types do not match when a generic List[object] was added directly to an array.
impact: Temporary merge stopped during table append; finally removed the temporary root; formal data stayed at f152.
correction: Converted the list with ToArray(), verified the temporary root was absent, then performed a fresh full run.

symptom: A trailing Where-Object property-mode expression omitted the required operator form.
impact: The two cell audit files were already valid; only the printed unexpected-change statistic failed.
correction: Re-imported both files and independently confirmed 6125 audited cells, 1225 changes, and 0 unexpected changes.

symptom: Several Where-Object property-mode expressions were constructed without valid operator syntax.
impact: The first derived rebase-signoff-validation.json falsely reported failure; source evidence and signoff were unchanged.
correction: Recomputed with script blocks and replaced the derived JSON; final status is passed.
